axes.model_access: The official docs line (learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio, fetched directly 200 on 2026-10-21) covers model and generative-answers configuration; the selectable-model list has not been verified item by item. The platform is deeply bound to the Microsoft ecosystem (Dataverse/Power Platform).
axes.runtime: Pure cloud hosting: agents run on the Microsoft 365 / Power Platform cloud; no self-hosted form.
axes.local_files: Knowledge sources connect to in-platform data such as SharePoint/files/Dataverse; it hosts no local-file runtime.
axes.background: Cloud-hosted residency is the default form; triggers and automation connect via Power Automate (official docs line).
axes.tools: Official docs list the topics/actions/connectors system (Power Platform connector ecosystem); MCP support status not verified item by item.
axes.context: Conversation topics and variables are the official context-organization scheme; cross-session memory mechanisms not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: Enterprise identity/governance follows the Microsoft 365 system (Entra ID etc.); data residency and compliance follow Microsoft commercial terms.
axes.fit: Fits: Microsoft 365/Power Platform-installed enterprises, governance ready-made, distribution inside the M365 ecosystem. Does not fit: outside the Microsoft ecosystem; self-hosting.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the tool-calling and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no workflow-platform-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
